hero.heading: Window Film and Windshield Chip Repair for Henderson, NV
hero.intro: BC Glass and Tint is a family owned window tint, auto glass and blinds shop at 1633 Boulder City Pkwy in Boulder City, about 20 minutes from Henderson. We are not a Henderson company and we do not have a Henderson storefront. Henderson customers drive out to our shop for vehicle work, and for homes and commercial buildings we come to you. Every film we install is computer-cut ceramic and carries a lifetime manufacturer warranty. We have been doing this since 1994, and we are open Tuesday to Saturday, 9am to 5pm.

content.heading: What Henderson Customers Come to Us For
bullets: Residential and commercial window film, installed at your building. Mobile service covers homes and commercial buildings, not vehicles.
Windshield chip repair. We can usually fill and seal a small chip or crack before it spreads.
Windshield replacement, arranged with a glass specialist we work with, with the glass ordered to your VIN. Chip repair we do in our own shop.
Ceramic auto tint at the shop, computer-cut, with no trimming on your glass.
Blinds and motorized window treatments, custom fit to your windows.
Clear bra paint protection and ceramic coating, at the shop.

facts.heading: Why Henderson Homeowners Tint
facts.sub: These are Las Vegas valley climate figures, the same sun Henderson sits under. Each one lists its own source.

items.term: About 78 days a year in the Las Vegas valley reach the 100s.
items.detail: That is most of a Nevada summer spent fighting heat through untreated glass.
items.source: Source: National Weather Service Las Vegas 1991-2020 climate normals.

items.term: About 9 days a year reach 110 degrees or hotter.
items.detail: Ceramic film is what makes a real difference on those days.
items.source: Source: National Weather Service Las Vegas 1991-2020 climate normals.

items.term: Peak UV index averages 9.7 in July, the highest month of the year.
items.detail: That kind of UV fades furniture, flooring and upholstery through an untinted window.
items.source: Source: uvindex.io UV index data for Las Vegas.

items.term: The valley sees 300 or more sunny days a year.
items.detail: Sun exposure is a year-round fact of life here, not just a summer event.
items.source: Source: uvindex.io Las Vegas climate data.

items.term: Our ceramic auto film blocks up to 99% of UV.
items.detail: That is the number that actually protects what is inside your vehicle.

areas.heading: Areas of Henderson We Work In

groups.heading: Established Henderson Neighborhoods
groups.text: We get regular calls from Wagon Wheel, the College area, Horizon and Green Valley, among other established parts of Henderson. A lot of what we replace in these neighborhoods is film that has gone purple, started to bubble, or lifted at the edges after years under the Nevada sun.

groups.heading: Newer Henderson Communities
groups.text: We also work in newer Henderson communities, including Cadence, Inspirada and Lake Las Vegas. A big new window wall facing west is exactly the situation film is built for, and the first summer in a new house is usually when a homeowner notices it.

areas.closing: More than 300,000 people live in Henderson, one of the largest communities within a short drive of our shop.

items.question: Do you come out to Henderson, or do I come to you?
items.answer: Vehicles always come to our Boulder City shop for tint, chip repair and windshield work. Windows do not move, so for homes and commercial buildings in Henderson, our mobile service comes to you.

items.question: How far is your shop from Henderson?
items.answer: About 20 minutes, roughly 11 miles, mostly along Boulder Highway. That is an approximation, not a guarantee, since traffic and your starting point in Henderson both change it.

items.question: Is the tint you install legal in Nevada?
items.answer: Yes. In Nevada, film on your front side windows has to let through not less than 35 percent of light, with a 7 percent tolerance, counting the glass and the film together, and it has to be nonreflective. The windshield can only carry a strip across the very top. We install fully legal tint and can recommend the darkest legal shade for your vehicle. See Nevada window tint law explained. Source: Nevada Revised Statutes 484D.440.

items.question: Do you do windshield replacement for Henderson vehicles?
items.answer: Yes, it is arranged through us. We do not keep windshields in stock, so the glass is ordered to your VIN and you are scheduled once it arrives. Chip repair we do in our own shop. The replacement itself is arranged with a glass specialist we work with, and we help with the order, the booking and the insurance claim. One call, one point of contact.

items.question: Can you do a whole house, or a new build?
items.answer: Yes. Mobile service covers homes and new builds in Henderson. Tell us roughly how many windows and we will give you a free quote before any work starts. Most jobs are finished on site in a single visit.
